analysis: Documentation-only units of docs/architecture/inference.md (base lines 4931-5377) were examined. The changed base ranges in these units are 5221-5224 (the cluster runtime facts paragraph) and 5245 (code map). On the head side, the paragraph at 5230-5235 now says a signed release computes the approval digests from its own final app and registers them (`cluster_runtime`). The guided setup then matches a served approval against the installed app and chosen model using the same computation (DistributedInstalledFiles.digest/verify, DistributedCapabilityProbe.verify, resourcePolicySHA256). This changes the documented provenance of cluster runtime approvals from setup-registered to release-registered. The integrity analog of A-011/A-017 (approved artifact identity) depends on the release lane's registration authority and on the member still comparing against its own installed files (head 5236ff, unchanged list items). That code and the release workflow are not in this batch, so no regression can be shown. Integration should confirm the following against the provider-release docs and code: the guided setup still verifies local file digests before accepting a served approval, and served approvals cannot be substituted by an adversarial coordinator or provider. Head 3528-3536 adds a health-file split (service-health.json vs part-health.json, with a PID check); that excerpt is outside these units. It is plausibly a local-liveness availability control under TB-003, with no evident new exposure. Base 5321 (MTP assistant selection) appears among the changed ranges but its content was not visible in the patch; no security relevance is evident. The remaining text (Qwen TP media, prefix cache disabled for media ingress at 5195-5196, T-041 tenant partitions at 4994) is unchanged context.
